scenes.headline: You've never once hit "OK, time to stop."
scenes.voiceover: Your screen time alert has an ignore button. You use it every day.

scenes.headline: Drift doesn't ask. It locks.
scenes.voiceover: Drift shields your worst apps. There's nothing to dismiss.

scenes.headline: Do something real first.
scenes.voiceover: Finish actual tasks to earn your minutes back.

scenes.headline: Your scroll, paid in full.
scenes.voiceover: Every minute on your feed is a minute you earned.
